title: Add typed mechanics for all SRD condition records
description:
Finding source:
- ChatGPT found all 15 condition records exist and prose is accurate, but deterministic tools cannot apply them without parsing prose.
- Codex example: condition:blinded is likely gameplay-mechanical but not typed enough.

Scope:
- blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, grappled, incapacitated, invisible, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious, exhaustion.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every condition record has typed mechanics sufficient for combat/check/save/movement/action tooling.
- Represent attack-roll effects, ability-check/save effects, movement restrictions, action/reaction restrictions, incapacitation, awareness/vision effects, advantage/disadvantage, automatic failures, attack targeting effects, and exhaustion levels where applicable.
- Tests demonstrate deterministic querying of representative effects without parsing prose.
close_reason: Added generated typed mechanics for all SRD condition records, schema validation, committed-pack query tests, and regenerated pack output.
